product_one_liner.value: Quantum Metric is a digital analytics platform for business, technology, and analytics teams that captures customer behavior, identifies experience problems and their business impact, and helps teams prioritize improvements.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as a digital analytics platform for business, technology, and analytics teams, and describes capturing user data, diagnosing issues, and prioritizing improvements.

pricing_page.notes: Quantum Metric has a public pricing page. It explains that pricing depends on factors such as annual session volume and directs prospective customers to talk with sales rather than listing fixed prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company's case-study pages identify Lululemon and Ashley Furniture as customers. | named_customers.0: The customer case study page identifies Lululemon as a Quantum Metric customer. | named_customers.1: The customer case study page identifies Ashley Furniture as a Quantum Metric customer.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports a size of 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile names Colorado Springs, CO as its headquarters locality. | hq_country: The company profile identifies the headquarters locality as Colorado Springs and the country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: Quantum Metric's company story identifies 2015 as the year Mario Ciabarra and David Wang founded it.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index shows product, perspectives, and best-practices content. A close candidate discusses the agentic analytics concept but does not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built; the evidence does not meet the specified threshold for an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The homepage's resources/navigation and the docs-subdomain pages reviewed provide marketing content rather than a public help article or developer documentation collection; the support landing page exposes a Knowledge Base link but no readable articles in the reviewed content. QMU guide entries link to registration pages. On this evidence, public product documentation meeting the requested several-article criterion was not found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists eight open titles, including account executive and solutions engineer roles, and none is an AI, ML, or data-science role by title.

model_provider.notes: The product announcement publicly states that Felix Agentic leverages Gemini models.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page says the company has attained SOC 2 attestation, is ISO/IEC 27001 certified, and complies with GDPR. It does not claim HIPAA or PCI DSS certification for Quantum Metric. | compliance_certs.0: The security page says Quantum Metric has attained SOC 2 attestation. | compliance_certs.1: The page explicitly says the company is ISO/IEC 27001 certified. | compliance_certs.2: The page says the company strictly complies with GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile identifies the most recent round as Series B. | funding_date: The funding profile gives January 2021 as the month of the most recent round. | funding_amount_usd: The funding history identifies the most recent round as a $200.0 million Series B in January 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: Reuters reported the $200 million financing on January 7, 2021. The funding profile identifies that January 2021 Series B as the latest round, which predates the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists Enterprise Account Executive and Strategic Account Executive openings, so the company is hiring for account executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Quantum Metric announced its Summer 2026 product capabilities, including Felix Agentic general availability, on July 16, 2026, within the six months before the requested date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated report says VP Alexi Hatch left the company (posted April 14, 2026), and a leadership profile records a July 1, 2026 start as VP of Engineering. Both dates fall within the requested 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Quantum Metric marketing job post names Salesforce, HubSpot, Qualified, Clay, and Tableau as tools in its marketing technology stack. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job post names Salesforce as part of its marketing technology stack. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job post names HubSpot as part of its marketing technology stack. | crm_stack_signal.2: The job post names Qualified as part of its marketing technology stack. | crm_stack_signal.3: The job post names Clay as part of its marketing technology stack. | crm_stack_signal.4: The job post names Tableau as part of its marketing technology stack.
